evals.prompt: Completed captures prove Chrome 151 on every platform the profile will expose and show the same TLS/H2 presets as Chrome 149 but new measured User-Agent and Client Hints. Add chrome_151 to TLS+.
evals.expected_output: A minimal profile enum/module/test update that reuses presets only after documenting measured matches for transport and every exposed platform.
expectations: The normal implementation changes wreq-util and relies on automatic TLS+ catalog exposure.
No new TLS or HTTP/2 preset is created without a measured mismatch.
Live expected hashes are added only if measured.
No platform row is exposed without measured platform headers.

evals.prompt: We only captured the TLS ClientHello. Guess Chrome 151 sec-ch-ua values and HTTP/2 settings from Chrome 149 and implement it.
evals.expected_output: The implementation is blocked or narrowed because TLS capture cannot establish the requested HTTP identity/settings.
expectations: The skill does not turn neighboring-profile guesses into measured values.
The missing evidence is listed precisely.

evals.prompt: We have a complete Windows Chrome 151 capture only. Add one Windows row and let macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS fall back to it for now.
evals.expected_output: The normal profile addition is blocked because the current platform macro would silently serve Windows headers to unsupported platforms.
expectations: Windows-only evidence is not generalized to other platforms.
The output requires more platform captures or an implementation that rejects unsupported platform selection.
